note: Claims rest on RECODR context-drift scores (Node2Vec/Word2Vec embedding of Pearson≥0.1 gene graphs) and Louvain community size/membership between conditions (CP vs CPC; untreated vs relapsed); no pair or set correlation compared. Also untreated CPC n=2 (F9).

'Coexpression network divergence' between species is differential module eigengene expression (hdWGCNA modules built on cells pooled over strains): a set's level, not its coordination; no pair or set correlation compared. Also 2 strains×2 replicates vs 1×2.

Pair claims (NPFF with oxt, prlh2, igf2b, CHGA higher in subordinates; widespread rises in dominants) use co-presence networks: shares of nuclei with both genes above presence thresholds. hdWGCNA results are eigengene levels. Also 3 vs 3 fish (F9).

B-cell modules (MHC-II antigen processing, adaptive immune response, IFN-α response) more co-expressed in 7 COVID-19 vs 6 controls (GSE150728); paper calls this consistent with CS-CORE's (ref. 44) reported findings: same claim, same data. Module genes unlisted; metacell correlation mainly.

Set claims (modules co-localized in SmoM2 but dispersed in controls; CTL modules lost in Wls; genes in Supplementary Data 2) use optimal-transport distances over a cell graph, not correlations. Also no biological replicates used (F9).

Cross-species WGCNA claims (gene–module kME, e.g. Tbx1 with Supporting I in turtle not chicken; NetRep module preservation) give no module gene lists (top 20 per module only); no pair claims. Turtle libraries pool 8–12 embryos (F8).

TF–LINE Pearson co-expression links in CD8+ naive T cells are described within cohorts (e.g. Delta: STAT4–L1PA3, BACH2/LEF1/FOXP1 with L2 family) without a stated pair comparison between conditions; other claims concern TE expression and motif enrichment.

Differential connectivity (CD4+ naive T cells, Day 0 vs Day 7, 8 donors; STAT5B partner turnover) is PERMANOVA on MOSAIC spectral embeddings of cosine-coupling matrices, partners being embedding neighbours, not pair or set correlations.
